title: Mental Health Demand & Supply Analysis (Capstone)
description: Forecasted regional mental-health service demand and compared it against provider supply to surface coverage gaps and actionable resource-planning insights. Built an end-to-end analytics workflow: data cleaning, feature engineering, time-series modeling, and stakeholder-ready visualization.

title: Wallet Wizard: Personal Finance Tracker
description: A full-stack budgeting and expense tracking web app with authentication, REST APIs, and a responsive UI. Built with React/Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL; designed to help users monitor spending and build better financial habits.

title: Adaptive Virtual Assistant (AVA) — LLM Workflows & Evaluation
description: Built and iterated LLM-powered workflows for an ed-tech assistant: prompt + rubric design, structured outputs, evaluation criteria, and quality analysis against real student tasks. Focused on reliability, consistency, and measurable improvements. (Project is private; details available upon request.)

title: NIH Grant Activity Classifier (Machine Learning)
description: Trained a multi-class model to predict NIH grant activity series (F/T/K/R) from structured award signals using public NIH RePORTER data (FY2018–FY2023, 118k+ records). Best baseline achieved ~0.93 macro-F1 on validation.

title: Enterprise Security Data Pipeline (Data Engineering)
description: Built a data pipeline to consolidate and analyze security-related datasets, enabling faster monitoring and investigation. Emphasized data quality, reproducibility, and scalable processing for downstream analytics.
